directory_policies.notes.1: Coursework preparation: The department describes CS-minor-equivalent preparation for competitive applicants. A CS undergraduate degree is optional.

source_excerpt: MS applicants can apply without the GRE or a CS undergraduate major. The department describes preparation equivalent to a CS minor for competitive candidates.
